description: Set ABSOLUTE on-hand inventory levels at an Internal (managed) warehouse — the opening-stock step of tenant onboarding, after import_historical_sales_orders has seeded the catalog. Each line sets the item's on-hand to the given quantity (not a delta) at the warehouse's default location, with a full audit trail and cost layers. Items not listed are left untouched, so chunking a large catalog across calls is safe, and re-sending the same levels is a no-op. Provide unitCost for items whose cost is unknown to Spark (e.g. seeded from order history) so COGS and carrying-cost math work. Max 500 lines per call.

clientId.description: Optional client id (GUID) for operator (unpinned) credentials on 3PL tenants: confines SKU/UPC matching to that client's items — get ids from list_clients. Client-pinned credentials omit this; the credential decides.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated idempotency key; required with previewReceipt to commit.

levels.description: Inventory levels to set (max 500 per call).

quantity.description: Absolute on-hand quantity to set (>= 0). Not a delta.

unitCost.description: Unit cost. Updates the item's cost and prices the created cost layer — set this for items seeded from order history, which land with cost 0.

upc.description: Item UPC/barcode, used when SKU is absent or unmatched.

preview.description: Step 1 of the required two-step write: set true to validate, resolve the identifiers, and receive a structured preview of the resolved absolute targets plus a single-use previewReceipt. Nothing is written until the commit call.

previewReceipt.description: Step 2 of the required two-step write: the receipt returned by the preview call. Supply together with a fresh idempotencyKey to commit; calls without it are refused.

warehouseId.description: Optional Internal warehouse id (GUID). May be omitted when the tenant has exactly one Internal warehouse.

name: set_inventory_levels
title: Set Inventory Levels
